name: NANA TOUR with SEVENTEEN
description:
PD Na, a 20-year veteran of travel entertainment shows, got a new job as a tour guide and became Guide Na!

He's the tour guide for SEVENTEEN who's going on a vacation into the summer of Italy!

videos.title: EP1-1. Don't Let SEVENTEEN Know
videos.overview: NANA TOUR opening event! Operation "Kidnapping SEVENTEEN" starts now!

videos.title: EP1-2. Off to Italy
videos.overview: Get on the plane, into the rhythm! Here we go, Italy! SEVENTEEN is beyond excited for the vacation! Get the full rundown.

videos.title: EP1-3. First Step of the Travel
videos.overview: Their first destination of the group tour in Italy is Rome! Find out SEVENTEEN's 13 ways to enjoy the Colosseum.

videos.title: EP1-4. Something Happened in Their House
videos.overview: The travelers take breaks, but their fun never stops! SEVENTEEN must beat Guide Na in a game to win toiletries!

videos.title: EP1-5. Next Episode
videos.overview: Something in between a tour and a game.

videos.title: EP2-1. Good Morning
videos.overview: After the buzziest nightfall, here comes the morning! SEVENTEEN in the romantic morning of Europe.

videos.title: EP2-2. Roman Holiday
videos.overview: After leisurely sightseeing around the Arch, they have a lunch feast at a celebrity-approved restaurant!

videos.title: EP2-3. On the Bus
videos.overview: A chaotic trivia quiz battle to win iced coffee on the way to enjoy the stunning nature of Tuscany!

videos.title: EP2-4. Today's Chefs, SEVENTEEN
videos.overview: It's showtime, let's cook! SEVENTEEN shows off their 10-year-old teamwork in the kitchen.

videos.title: EP2-5. Silent Screams
videos.overview: The ultimate game to decide the fate of their first optional tour! SEVENTEEN never gives up, and never stops laughing!

videos.title: EP2-6. Next Episode
videos.overview: The day has come! NANA TOUR's first optional tour day.

videos.title: EP3-1. Silent Screams Part 2
videos.overview: Endless miscommunication and chaotic confusion... Win the game to choose your optional tour!

videos.title: EP3-2. The optional tour day
videos.overview: Let's enjoy Italy 526% with the optional tours! Follow along with SEVENTEEN to fly in the sky and wander around the city!

videos.title: EP3-3. Nice to meet you, Salute!
videos.overview: After the optional winery tour, there came a wine festival for all! A food and wine extravaganza left SEVENTEEN full and pleasantly buzzed!

videos.title: EP3-4. What are you doing?
videos.overview: To earn extra pocket money, complete your mission without anyone knowing! But the members of SEVENTEEN would never let that happen that easily!

videos.title: EP3-5. Next Episode
videos.overview: Let's go for optional local tours!

videos.title: EP4-1. What are you doing? Part. 2
videos.overview: The challengers can't stop, but the interruptions won't stop either! Who will complete their missions and win the prize money?

videos.title: EP4-2. Food tours in the provinces
videos.overview: Let's get "kung chi pak chi" with the strawberry game and win your favorite tour! SEVENTEEN enjoying a range of optional tours.

videos.title: EP4-3. Don't stop this healing
videos.overview: Leisurely wander around the landmarks, or learn how to cook Italian dishes! Full of happiness and full of food, it's a "very nice" day for SEVENTEEN!

videos.title: EP4-4. Next Episode
videos.overview: Spoiler Alert: SEVENTEEN's talent show is out of this world!

videos.title: EP5-1. Talent show
videos.overview: SEVENTEEN is so eager to make everyone laugh! Check out the craziest, funniest, and most impressive talent show!

videos.title: EP5-2. Towards the last journey
videos.overview: Off to the beautiful seaside town, Forte dei Marmi! Admiring the sunset at the beach, SEVENTEEN finds a peace of mind.

videos.title: EP5-3. Next Episode
videos.overview: The last chapter of NANA TOUR.

videos.title: EP6-0. Activities (Feat. zip line)
videos.overview:
SEVENTEEN is zipping through the sky on a zipline!

Let's enjoy the landscape and feel the excitement and happiness!

videos.title: EP.6-1. Seafood feast!
videos.overview:
Boost your happy energy with fresh seafood!

SEVENTEEN seems to know how to enjoy the food without limits.

videos.title: EP6-2. Mafia game
videos.overview:
"Night has come...Let's get into the game!"

SEVENTEEN deep diving into the high-level detective game.

videos.title: EP6-3. The last page of the tour
videos.overview:
NANA TOUR's last destination, Porto Venere!

SEVENTEEN walking through the alleyway and enjoying the boat tour.

videos.title: EP6-4. NANA TOUR_WORLD
videos.overview:
The journey with SEVENTEEN is like a déjà vu of heaven!

Wrapping up the vacation with an honest heart-to-heart talk.

videos.title: EP6-5. Our "campfire"
videos.overview:
You've been next to me, and I've been next to you.

We are making each other grow!
